sources.name: All India Survey on Higher Education
sources.authority: Ministry of Education, Government of India
dataLimitations: Publication year must be checked for each dataset.
Historical statistics must not be presented as current institution-level facts.
A dataset's existence does not establish that it covers every current institution.

sources.name: Joint Seat Allocation Authority
dataLimitations: Counselling schedules must be associated with the correct admission year.
Seat matrices and eligibility rules must come from applicable official documents.
Revised notices must supersede older versions when applicable.

sources.name: Central Seat Allocation Board
dataLimitations: Applicable counselling schemes and admission years must be identified.
Dates and eligibility must be verified against the relevant official notice.

sources.name: Medical Counselling Committee
dataLimitations: Counselling schedules and seat information are year-specific.
Revised notices must be checked before presenting dates as current.

sources.name: National Career Service
dataLimitations: An opportunity must have a verifiable source and application route.
Application deadlines and availability must not be inferred.
Eligibility, salary, and employer details must not be invented.
